role: Coordinated semantic Evidence, content-derived Run identity, terminal persistence, and atomic publication successor for the selected A-prime lifecycle.
author: phase1a-evidence-successor-lane

authority.integrationAuthority: coordinator-only after independent combined rereview and separate CD-RT-5 disposition

reviewFindingTransfers.closure: SemanticEvidenceV1, EvidenceDigest, RUN-ID-V1 and TerminalRunV1 are exact closed byte grammars with independently regenerated combined goldens; RunId is externally visible only after atomic final commit.
The dependency graph is EP5/RT10 -> VERSIONING v5 -> Evidence v4, with exact artifact/checker/grammar pins and no Evidence back-edge in VERSIONING capabilityJoin.
The selected EP5 semantic-authority and RT10 typed raw-custody contracts are transferred injectively into Evidence v4; semantic commitments never serve as physical raw-object keys.

Plan authority, ActivationManifest bytes/ref and exact ProjectId-scoped SemanticObjectBindingV1 records are recomputed and admitted before core invocation; no raw JSON, caller ref or boolean bypass constructs authority.

recursiveRequestIdExclusion.rule: RequestId and ExecutionId are operational-only. Every named semantic record is exact/closed; neither identity may occur at the root or any nested semantic item. Unknown fields reject rather than being ignored.
recursiveRequestIdExclusion.differential: Two RequestIds and distinct ExecutionIds over byte-equal semantic inputs and sealed target produce identical inventory, SemanticEvidence, EvidenceDigest, RunId, TerminalRun and runSealRef; they differ only in AttemptRunLinkV1 and operational records.
recursiveRequestIdExclusion.negativeControl: Inject requestId or executionId at each root and each nested semantic collection item; exact decoding/admission rejects before hashing or core authority use.

dependencies.dependencyDirection: EP5 and RT10 feed VERSIONING v5; Evidence v4 binds all three. VERSIONING v5 contains no Evidence dependency, so the graph is acyclic.

importedAuthorityContract.ownershipRule: Evidence imports and verifies this exact EP5 grammar and golden; it MUST NOT allocate a competing tag, field set, domain, or commitment recipe.
importedAuthorityContract.preCoreRule: PlanId, PlanIntent commitment, ExecutionPlan commitment, ActivationManifest bytes/ref, ProjectId scope, and typed semantic-object bindings are recomputed and admitted before core invocation. Raw JSON, caller-supplied refs, booleans, or untyped hashes cannot construct the opaque authority handle.

semanticObjectBinding.name: SemanticObjectBindingV1
domainUses: derived witness canonical ordering only; never authority by itself

bindingSchema.resolverRule: Rehash raw bytes, decode and canonical-reencode by recordKind, recompute the domain-separated semantic ref, require ProjectId equality and one exact binding. Physical custody APIs accept only the resulting RawObjectKeyV1.

scalarEncoding.text: NFC UTF-8, no BOM, non-empty, no U+0000..U+001F or U+007F; identifiers and enums retain their closed ASCII grammar
scalarEncoding.canonicalUnsignedDecimal: ASCII digits; zero is 0; otherwise no leading zero

recordRules.presence: every declared field exactly once; no optional or undeclared bytes
recordRules.sets: sort complete item record bytes unsigned; reject duplicates instead of silently deduplicating
recordRules.decoding: reject non-NFC, noncanonical decimal, tag/order/length mismatch, duplicate, omitted, unknown, trailing, or overlong bytes

RawProofInventoryV1.equalityRule: Exact projection of RT10 SemanticCapabilityClosureV3.proofRefs after requiring identityKind=raw-cas and every item ProjectId equal the outer ProjectId. Preserve recordCasRef, recordKind, and requiredForCapability exactly; zero items is permitted only when RT10 validates that capability.

TerminalRunV1.rawHashRule: runSealRef = sha256:<lowerhex SHA-256(exact TerminalRunV1 bytes)>; runSealRef is external and MUST NOT occur in TerminalRunV1.

commitments.canonicalJsonRawCas: sha256:<lowerhex SHA-256(opensip-canonical-json-v1(value))>; no domain, BOM, whitespace, or trailing newline

semanticJoins.authority: ProjectId/PlanId and all three plan/manifest commitments equal the opaque admitted EP5 authority; the EP5 bundle authority ref equals that seal ref.
semanticJoins.evaluation: The raw EP5 bundle ref binds exact activated members, Coverage refs, evaluations, outcomes and proof unions. EP5 recomputes universe, outcome-set, verdict-input commitment and verdict; the four SemanticEvidence summary fields equal those exact outputs.
semanticJoins.custody: The raw RT10 closure ref binds semantic roots, exact EP5 SemanticObjectBindingV1 records, raw proofRefs, typed raw dependency edges, UNIT-ID-V3 units and sealed capability. Inventory equals proofRefs exactly and every RawObjectKeyV1 resolves with matching bytes and ProjectId.
semanticJoins.versioning: VERSIONING v5's six historical rows equal the EP5 roles and are present as RT10 typed raw proof refs at verifiable. Evidence copies no kind/role lattice beyond the exact raw inventory projection.
semanticJoins.noCycles: Authority -> EP5 bundle -> RT10 closure -> raw inventory -> SemanticEvidence -> EvidenceDigest -> RunId -> TerminalRun -> external runSealRef. RT10 closure and UNIT-ID-V3 are RunId-free.

projection.name: EvidenceReadProjectionV1
projection.rule: Recompute on every stored read from verified persisted bytes plus RT10 UnitAvailabilityRecordV2 and VERSIONING v5 verifier availability. Never store, CAS-address, or include this projection in EvidenceDigest/RunId/TerminalRun.

calls: opensip_store.admit_evaluation_authority_seal_v1(ProjectStore, VerifiedPlanAuthorityV1, canonicalSeal, canonicalManifest, semanticBindings, semanticRecords) -> AdmittedEvaluationAuthoritySealV1
opensip_evidence.project_read_v1(VerifiedStoredRunV1, RT10 mutableState, VERSIONING v5 availability) -> EvidenceReadProjectionV1
apiContract.constructionRule: Constructors for opaque verified types are module-private. Core accepts only VerifiedEvaluationAuthorityV2. No overload accepts raw JSON, a supplied PlanId/RunId/ref, or verified/pinned booleans. Candidate RunId is an internal non-Display/non-Serialize value used only by commit_prepared_run_v1; only CommittedRunV1 exposes it.

RunIndexV1.uniqueness: append-only; same key/same runSealRef is idempotent; same key/different ref is LEDGER.CORRUPT

AttemptRunLinkV1.uniqueness: one Run per Attempt; many Attempts may link the same content-derived Run

RunCustodyRootV1.boundary: operational reachability/lineage outside EvidenceDigest; unitIds are exact RT10 UNIT-ID-V3 values

transaction: Resolve and rehash all raw CAS bytes; validate typed semantic bindings, EP5 bundle, RT10 closure, inventory equality, admitted target equality, custody preparation and Attempt expected revision.
Derive EvidenceDigest and an opaque candidate RunId; build TerminalRunV1; write Terminal bytes to a private staging namespace not served by public CAS lookup.

In one serializable transaction publish-or-verify Terminal CAS visibility, RunIndexV1, AttemptRunLinkV1, RunCustodyRootV1 and custody pin transfer; enqueue run-committed in the same outbox transaction; remove the prepared journal.
Return CommittedRunV1 only after commit. A transaction failure emits no RunId and leaves no public Run index or terminal object.
recovery: Before journal: hidden/orphan CAS is garbage-collectable and no Run exists.
Journal exists but no index/link: rehydrate SemanticEvidence and custody, rederive the same candidate, and retry.
Commit succeeded but response was lost: exact Attempt link and Run index return the committed result idempotently.
Index/link both exist with exact refs: success. Neither exists: retry. Exactly one exists, or either conflicts: LEDGER.CORRUPT; never guess or overwrite.
Concurrent semantically identical Attempts converge on one RunIndex/RunCustodyRoot and retain distinct AttemptRunLink/outbox rows.
storeContract.publicVisibility: Analysis events, logs, diagnostics, errors, responses and public CAS/index lookup forbid the candidate RunId before final commit. Stored-view may carry an already committed RunId and creates no new Run.

admissionAndSealOrdering: Validate RequestId and resolve an explicit project retention policy plus admitted sealed-capability target before Attempt allocation. With CD-RT-5 unresolved, an absent default is REQUEST.UNSATISFIABLE and creates no Attempt.
Allocate ExecutionId/AttemptRecord and freeze PlanIntent, AdmissionDescriptor and sealed-capability target; RequestId/ExecutionId remain operational and outside semantic commitments.

Converge snapshot, derive/recompute PlanId and ExecutionPlan commitment, freeze Coverage/core inputs, derive ActivationManifest and EP5 EvaluationAuthoritySeal, and admit exact semantic bindings/raw records before core invocation.
Invoke pure core only with VerifiedEvaluationAuthorityV2; validate EP5 bundle and exact Coverage/universe/outcomes/proofs/verdict.

Derive RT10 semantic roots/bindings, typed raw proofRefs/edges, UNIT-ID-V3 units and RunId-free closure. Require sealedCapability equal the frozen target; prepare all required custody without downgrade.
Encode SemanticEvidence/EvidenceDigest, write the Run-free journal, and enter the atomic final commit protocol. Only committed publication exposes RunId.

sealedCapabilityContract.targetTiming: Frozen at request validation and committed in the admitted PlanIntent before Attempt/core. It cannot be selected after observing verdict or current availability.
sealedCapabilityContract.finalization: Final sealedCapability equals the admitted target exactly after RT10 closure and custody preparation. Unsupported target or failed custody does not silently demote; no Run commits.
sealedCapabilityContract.readTime: RT10 alone derives effectiveCapability from mutable raw-object availability. Availability, leases and lineage may change effectiveCapability but never sealedCapability, SemanticEvidence, EvidenceDigest, RunId or TerminalRun.
sealedCapabilityContract.productFork: CD-RT-5 alone decides the product default. This candidate supports explicit admitted targets and rejects an absent default; it does not claim or apply product acceptance.

d9Mapping.vocabularyRule: No new D9 class, code, axis, precedence, or exit mapping is introduced.

positiveControls.assert: Accepted EP5/RT10 vector reproduces every byte/hash above.
Two RequestIds and distinct ExecutionIds over equal semantic inputs/cap produce byte-identical inventory/Evidence/RUN/Terminal and one Run index with two Attempt links.
Removing one replay-only raw object changes only RT10 effectiveCapability/read projection; every persisted byte/hash remains exact.
Changing the admitted sealed target changes SemanticEvidence and RUN-ID-V1 even if every other scalar were equal.
Each documented crash point converges to no public Run or the one exact committed Run; no partial identity is observable.

authority: arbitrary PlanId even when downstream values are coherently recomputed
one semantic key mapped to multiple raw records
raw JSON or verified/pinned boolean bypass; core invocation count must remain zero
semantic: old EP4 semantic ref used as raw custody target
each lifecycle/mutable/physical field injected at root or nested depth
run: mutate each of the six framed fields
store: crash before stage/after stage/after journal/during transaction/after commit before response
versioning: current availability or effective capability copied into immutable semantics

invariants.assert: EvaluationAuthoritySealV1 is exact EP5-owned pre-core authority; unverified input never invokes core.
SemanticEvidence binds exact Project/Plan/seal, Coverage/universe/outcomes/proofs/verdict, raw proof inventory, sealed capability and RT10 closure without lifecycle or mutable state.
Semantic commitments and raw CAS refs are nominally distinct; only EP5 SemanticObjectBindingV1 resolves between them.
RT10 closure and UNIT-ID-V3 are content-derived and RunId-free; availability/lease/lineage/effective capability remain outside EvidenceDigest.
RUN-ID-V1 is exactly the six-field domain-framed digest and is externally visible only after atomic final commit.
TerminalRunV1 has no self-reference; external runSealRef is the raw exact-byte hash.
RunIndex, Attempt link, custody root and postcommit event publish atomically and recover idempotently.
VERSIONING v5 preserves v4 custody and Evidence binds exact EP5/RT10/VERSIONING v5 bytes without a dependency cycle.
Sealed capability is the pre-core admitted target, never a post-verdict maximum or silent downgrade.
RequestId/ExecutionId variation and current availability cannot change semantic bytes or content Run identity.

retainedResiduals.statement: Product authority must select the default retention/capability posture; this candidate does not.
The atomic publication/recovery mechanism is specified and mutation-tested as an artifact, not demonstrated in a live store.
Lexical ProjectId scoping does not demonstrate physical backend isolation, symlink/hardlink/mount safety, or operator controls.
An independent reviewer who authored none of EP5, RT10, VERSIONING v5 or Evidence v4 must review the combined packet before any application.

sealRecommendation: DO NOT SEAL OR APPLY. Candidate is implementation-ready at the contract level, but CD-RT-5, live-store evidence, independent combined rereview and coordinator integration remain outstanding.
